questions.text: The organelle responsible for the release of energy during respiration is the
questions.explanation: Mitochondria carry the enzymes for aerobic respiration and produce most of the cell's ATP.

questions.text: Which component of blood is mainly responsible for defence against infection?
questions.explanation: Leucocytes engulf pathogens and produce antibodies; red cells carry oxygen and platelets aid clotting.

questions.text: Ultrafiltration in the mammalian kidney takes place in the
questions.explanation: High blood pressure in the glomerulus forces small molecules into the Bowman's capsule, forming the glomerular filtrate.

questions.text: Photosynthesis in green plants takes place mainly in the
questions.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which traps light energy for the manufacture of carbohydrates.

questions.text: A cross between two heterozygous tall pea plants (Tt × Tt) produces offspring in the phenotypic ratio
questions.explanation: The genotypic ratio is 1TT : 2Tt : 1tt, but since T is dominant the phenotypes appear as 3 tall : 1 short.

questions.text: The tissue that conducts water and mineral salts in flowering plants is the
questions.explanation: Xylem vessels transport water and dissolved minerals upwards; phloem translocates manufactured food.

questions.text: Malaria parasites are transmitted to humans by the
questions.explanation: Only the female Anopheles takes a blood meal and so transmits Plasmodium.

questions.text: Which hormone lowers the level of glucose in the blood?
questions.explanation: Insulin from the beta cells of the pancreas promotes the conversion of glucose to glycogen in the liver.

questions.text: Prolonged deficiency of ascorbic acid in the diet results in
questions.explanation: Ascorbic acid is vitamin C, and its deficiency causes scurvy, marked by bleeding gums and slow wound healing.

questions.text: The enzyme in saliva acts on
questions.explanation: Salivary amylase (ptyalin) hydrolyses starch to maltose in the mouth.

questions.text: The class of vertebrates whose bodies are covered with feathers is
questions.explanation: Feathers, a beak without teeth and hollow bones are diagnostic features of Aves.

questions.text: In a food chain, green plants occupy the trophic level of
questions.explanation: Green plants manufacture their own food and so form the first trophic level as producers.

questions.text: In humans, the sex of an offspring is determined by the
options: number of chromosomes in the zygote
questions.explanation: The ovum always carries X, while the sperm may carry X or Y, so the father's gamete decides the sex.

questions.text: The loss of water vapour from the aerial parts of a plant is called
questions.explanation: Transpiration occurs mainly through the stomata and creates the pull that draws water up the xylem.

questions.text: Binary fission is the method of reproduction in
questions.explanation: Amoeba divides into two equal daughter cells by binary fission; Hydra buds and yeast reproduces by budding.

questions.text: The theory of evolution by natural selection was proposed by
questions.explanation: Darwin argued that organisms best adapted to their environment survive and pass on their traits.

questions.text: A group of organisms of the same species living together in a given area is called a
questions.explanation: A population is one species; a community is all the populations in that habitat.

questions.text: The end products of anaerobic respiration in muscle cells are
questions.explanation: In oxygen debt, glucose is broken down incompletely to lactic acid with a small release of energy.

questions.text: The excretory structures of flatworms are the
questions.explanation: Flame cells remove excess water and nitrogenous waste in Platyhelminthes.

questions.text: The part of the eye that controls the amount of light entering it is the
questions.explanation: The iris adjusts the size of the pupil in bright and dim conditions.

questions.text: A purple colouration with Biuret reagent indicates the presence of
questions.explanation: Biuret reagent detects peptide bonds and turns purple in the presence of protein.

questions.text: The blood vessel that carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart is the
questions.explanation: The pulmonary vein is the exception among veins: it carries oxygenated blood to the left atrium.

questions.text: Gaseous exchange in insects takes place through the
questions.explanation: Air enters through spiracles and is carried directly to the tissues by a network of tracheae and tracheoles.

questions.text: Which of the following features adapts a seed for dispersal by wind?
options: A light seed with wing-like structures
questions.explanation: Light seeds with wings or parachutes of hairs are carried easily by air currents.

questions.text: An advantage of sexual reproduction over asexual reproduction is that it
options: produces offspring identical to the parent
increases genetic variation in the offspring
questions.explanation: The fusion of gametes from two parents recombines genes, giving variation on which selection can act.

questions.text: The bacterium found in the root nodules of leguminous plants is
questions.explanation: Rhizobium lives symbiotically in root nodules and fixes atmospheric nitrogen for the plant.

questions.text: The rate of transpiration in plants is increased by
questions.explanation: Heat raises evaporation and wind removes the saturated air around the stomata, steepening the diffusion gradient.

questions.text: The bone of the upper arm in mammals is the
questions.explanation: The humerus articulates with the scapula at the shoulder and with the radius and ulna at the elbow.

questions.text: The main role of decomposers in an ecosystem is to
questions.explanation: Bacteria and fungi break down dead organic matter, releasing minerals that producers reuse.

questions.text: The instrument used to measure relative humidity in a habitat is the
questions.explanation: A hygrometer measures humidity; an anemometer measures wind speed and a barometer measures atmospheric pressure.
